claims.en: Räikkönen debuted in Formula 1 with Sauber in 2001.

claims.en: Räikkönen moved from Sauber to McLaren for the 2002 season.

claims.en: Räikkönen won the 2007 Formula 1 Drivers' World Championship with Ferrari.

claims.en: Räikkönen won the 2018 United States Grand Prix for Ferrari.
